# GNK ASG — Social Account Setup Order

Status: preparation only. Do not publish automatically.

## Current account status

- LinkedIn: exists and can be used first after manual confirmation.
- Facebook: account/page still needs to be created.
- YouTube: channel still needs to be created.
- X: optional later; not part of the first activation cycle unless specifically approved.

## Recommended order

### 1. LinkedIn first

Reason:

- Account already exists.
- Best channel for corporate and professional positioning.
- Suitable for GNK ASG Insight articles.
- Safer than starting with multiple unfinished channels.

First use:

- Manual post only.
- Use the prepared LinkedIn draft from the social distribution package.
- Link to the public article, not the old preview route.
- Check that the shared preview shows the correct title, image and description before posting.

### 2. Facebook page second

Reason:

- Useful for broader public visibility.
- Can mirror selected GNK ASG Insight posts.
- Should not be automated until page identity, admin access and branding are confirmed.

Required before posting:

- Official page name confirmed.
- Page category confirmed.
- Logo uploaded.
- Cover/banner prepared.
- Website link added.
- Contact email added when info@gnk-asg.hr is active.

### 3. YouTube channel third

Reason:

- Requires more setup and video workflow.
- Should start only after a basic channel identity exists.
- Weekly video briefs should be prepared first and published manually.

Required before posting:

- Channel name confirmed.
- Handle confirmed if available.
- Logo uploaded.
- Banner prepared.
- Description prepared.
- First weekly brief script approved.
- Video format tested.

GNK ASG d.o.o.

### Facebook

Alternative:

GNK ASG d.o.o.

### YouTube

Alternative:

## Rules before automation

- No automatic posting before all accounts are confirmed.
- No password sharing in chat.
- Use manual first post on LinkedIn.
- Facebook and YouTube remain setup-only until created and approved.
- All posts should point to the public article or Insights archive, not preview routes.

## Next immediate action

Use LinkedIn first:

1. Open LinkedIn official account/page.
2. Start a new post.
3. Paste the article URL.
4. Wait for preview card.
5. Confirm title, description and image.
6. Paste LinkedIn text draft.
7. Review manually.
8. Publish only after final approval.
